paite: Huan gam a ka suahtak un, tuikulh min tuh Malta ahi chih ka theita uhi.
heading: Malta Ah Paul Gul In Atu
english: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.

paite: Tuikulh gam mite'n asiam theihtawp uh suah in hon na hehpih ua; vuah ahong zuk ziak leh khovot ziak in mei atoh ua, ka vek un hon na kipahpih uhi.
english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

paite: Paul in singlom khat atom a mei ah achih a, asat ziak in gul ahong vakkhia a, akhut a tu in atangden hi.
english: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

paite: Tuikulh gam mite'n ganhing akhut a kikhaiden amuh un, "Hiai mi tualthat ahi ding, tuipi a kipan taikhe mahleh diktatna in ahin phalta lou ahi,” achi uhi.
english: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n mei ah gul asingkhia a, bangmah achi kei hi.
english: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

paite: Amau bel abawk hiam, thakhat a puk pah a si ding in agingta uh; hun sawtpi angak nilouh ua, bangmah achi kei chih atheih un alungsim uh akheng ua, Pathian ahi achi zaw uhi.
english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

paite: Huai mun kiang ah huai tuikulh a hausapa, amin Publias a-om a, huai mi in ahon na kipahpih a, ni thum siamtak in ahon tungsak hi.
heading: Publias Hihdamna
english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

paite: Publias pa khosik leh santen vei in ana lum a; akiang ah Paul alut a, athum a, atung ah akhut koih in ahihdamta hi.
english: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

paite: Huai ahihdam khit in tuikulh a midang natna nei peuhmah ahong ua; adam chiatta uhi.
english: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.

paite: Huai mite'n nakpitak in ahon na pahtawi ua; ka pai ding un long ah ka vante uh ahong koih uhi.
english: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

paite: Huan kha thum nung in, Aleksandria kho long, phalbi a tuikulh a omsa, unau phik, Kastor leh Pollux lutang kisuanna long ah ka pai uhi.
heading: Rome Zuan A Zin Zelna
english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

paite: Sairakus khua ka tawn ua huai ah ni thum ka taam uhi.
english: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

paite: Huai a kipan ka paikawi ua, Rejiam khua ka tung ua; ni khat nung in sim huih ahong nung a, azing nawn in Puteoli khua ka tung nawn uhi.
english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

paite: Huai ah unaute ka mu ua, akiang uah ni sagih taam ding in ahon khou ua; huchibang in Rome kholam ah ka pai zelta uhi.
english: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

paite: Huan unaute'n ka Tanchin uh azaktak un huai a kipan in Appii dawr leh Khualbuk thumte omna chiang ah hong dawn ding in ahong kuan ua; Paul in huai mite amuh in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen a, alungmuang mahmahta hi.
english: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.

paite: Rome a ka lut un Paul bel avengpa sepaih kiang a amah kia a om aphal uhi.
heading: Rome Khopi Ah Paul
english: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

paite: Ni thum nung in, Paul in Juda heutute asamkhawm a; akihoukhawm ua, akiang uah, "Unaute leh mite aw, i pipute dan tung ah bangmah ka hihkhelh louh in leng Jerusalem a kipan in Rome a mite kiang ah ahon hentasak uhi.
english: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

paite: Amau ahon etchet khit un, sihna khop hial ka tung ah bangmah amuh louh ziak un khah ahon tum uhi.
english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

paite: Himahleh Judate'n huai asel ziak un Kaisar kiang tun lou thei ka hita kei a; himahleh ka chipihte hekna nei a hih bel ka hi kei hi.
english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

paite: Huai lam thu a noumau hon mu a hon houpih ding in ka hon sam ahi; Israelte lamet thilte toh kisai a khainiang bun ka hi ngal a," achi hi.
english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Na tanchin Judia gam a kipan lai in ka mu kei ua, unau hiai a hong omte kuamah in na tungtang thubuai bangmah apulak kei ua, gen leng agen ngei kei uhi.
english: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

paite: Himahleh hiai pawl zaw gam teng ah gensiat ahi ngal ua, nang bangchi in ahia na ngaih chih theih ka utzaw uhi,” achi uhi.
english: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”

paite: Huan ni achiam ua, huai atunna ah akiang ah mi tampi ahong ua; zing a kipan nitaklam pha in akiang uah huai thu ahilhchian a, Pathian lalgam thu atheisak a, Mosi Dan laibu thu leh zawlneite laibu thu in Jesu lam ah amaute athuzoh zel hi.
english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

paite: Khenkhat in athugen agingta ua, akhen in agingta kei uh.
english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

paite: Huan akituakta kei ua, Paul in thu agen khit in apaikheta uhi. Athugen tuh hiai ahi: Kha Siangthou in zawlnei Isai kam a na pipute uh kiang a athugen adik mahmah ahi chi in:
english: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,

paite: "Hiai chite kiang ah va gen in, bil in zaw na za na ding ua, angaihna ahihleh na thei kei hial ding uh; muh zaw na mu ding ua, theih ahihleh na thei kei hial ding uh.
english: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

paite: Hiai chite lungtang atakta a, abilte uh ana ngong deuh a, amit uh leng asi ua, huchi lou in zaw amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza ding ua, alungtang un leng athei ding uh, akiheikik ding ua, ke'n ka hihdam kha ding hi," achi, achih pen ahi.
english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’

paite: "Huaiziak in Pathian hotdamna thu Zentelte kiang a khakkhiak ahi chih thei un, amau bel ngaih leng angaikhe ding uh," achi hi.
english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

paite: Huchi a hiai thute agen khit nung in, Judate apawtkheta ua, alak uah nakpitak in kiselna apiang hi.
english: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.

paite: Huchi in kum nih vengveng ama inn luahna mun ah Paul a-om a, akiang a hoh peuhmah ana kipahpih hi.
english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,

paite: Pathian lalgam thu ahilh a, hangsantak in Toupa Jesu Khrist thu agen zel a, kuamah in amah akham kei uhi.
english: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.
